title: FAIR-QR: Enhancing Fairness-aware Information Retrieval through Query Refinement

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the exposure distribution of retrieved documents across biographic gender subgroups (male, female, non-binary, and unknown) using the attention-weighted ranking fairness (AWRF) metric to compare system-produced exposure against expected target exposure.

Measuring the exposure distribution of retrieved documents across 21 geographic location subgroups (e.g., Asia, North America) using the attention-weighted ranking fairness (AWRF) metric to ensure proportional representation in search results.
